prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright spring garden terrace of pale stone with blooming tulip beds, a low trimmed hedge, a standard-height garden gate and a bench, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as the figure, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, the camera set back far enough that the whole figure is visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on the figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

ONE real adult Swedish person with the face of a beautiful woman, the face exactly the same tone as the body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, very pale, cool skin, a soft white-silver highlighter along the cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones, pale icy-blue eyeshadow with a fine silver shimmer, pale softly brushed blonde brows, curled light-brown-tipped lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, a sheer frosted pale-pink lip, a cool, calm, faraway expression, cool ash-brown hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large platinum hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on platinum chain (a silver square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying six heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a silver ship's anchor, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a gold chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, an iron miniature anvil, a lead hammer head, a gold round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked gold rings. Extremely long round nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
Physique: the body of an extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous; the arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
Body Art: The bare skin is painted in Vietnamese sơn mài lacquer (deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with gold-leaf lotus blossoms), wide gold-leaf bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense eggshell-white scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers the whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of the hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of the feet. The face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
Pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground.
Footwear: Extreme black platform stiletto studded boots, the platform soles rising far higher than the ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
